mission.summary: GuiAgentLoopCore provides the core logic for bridging GUI frameworks and LLM agents

target_users.need: Building LLM-powered applications with GUI interfaces
Creating specialized agents for specific tasks
Claude, Gemini, Codex, and other AI models working with this codebase

core_value: Reliable, type-safe, and extensible foundation for GUI-LLM integration with predictable state management and clear component boundaries

core_functions.example: interpreter_manager.py manages chat sessions and state transitions
change_state_running() ensures state transitions are monotonic

success_metrics.target: New applications can integrate GuiAgentLoopCore in < 1 hour
Zero state transition bugs in production
New agents can be added without core modifications
Zero runtime type errors in message handling

design_philosophy.description: Prioritize system correctness over developer convenience. Hard invariants cannot be bypassed.
All state transitions, message types, and agent roles are explicitly defined. No magic behavior.
Each component has a single, well-defined responsibility. Clear boundaries between components.
All behavior is testable. Hard invariants have automated tests.
All terminology is normalized and defined in a formal ontology. No ambiguity.
